title: Measuring Representational Harms in Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing true positive rates of object mentions (e.g., 'tie' vs. 'dress') between perceived male and female subjects using logistic regression, measuring differences in omission rates of depicted people, and detecting gender-specific demeaning language (e.g., calling women 'girls' or using the adjective 'female' as a noun).

Analyzing false positive word inclusions (hallucinations, such as mentioning a 'gun') linked to racial stereotypes, comparing true positive object mention rates between darker and lighter skin tones, measuring differences in omission rates of depicted people, and detecting race-specific demeaning language (e.g., calling Black men 'boys' or referring to Black people as animals).
